name: Edmond's hat glider B, as found by JETCARP's search
description: A four-state priority rule found on the hat by JETCARP's reimplementation of James Edmond's evolutionary glider search, seeded with two tiles. It is Edmond's hat glider B (arXiv:2609.22579) in another table: with B's states renamed (1 to 3, 2 to 1, 3 to 2) the two tables give the same evolution cell for cell on this glider. The glider has one head and four to six wing tiles and moves one ring of tiles every two generations. Credit Edmond.
